classification_policy.REUSE_EXACT: Artifact integrity, immutable identity, assurance, and every available selected current dependency binding match.
classification_policy.REUSE_UPSTREAM_ONLY: Bytes remain useful, but the stage lacks a complete current dependency binding or depends on an earlier reopened stage.
classification_policy.RERENDER_REQUIRED: Candidate exists but current fact/template/prompt/policy-equivalent dependencies cannot preserve it.
classification_policy.REREVIEW_REQUIRED: Candidate/deterministic bytes remain usable but reviewer authority changed or is incomplete.
classification_policy.INVALID_STALE: Artifact identity, schema, inventory, receipt, verdict, or source revision is disproved.
classification_policy.MISSING: The expected current-revision stage artifact does not exist.

immutable_stage_attempts.note: CAS validation reconstructs request/result/seal/inventory; it proves transport integrity, not current semantic compatibility.
